branches: Canonical metadata determines branch independently of item.kind
Text returns String(attributedText.characters), including empty text
Image, missing/bad metadata and zero files return literal Unknown
Color returns original lowercase RGB formatter output
Multiple files preserve nonempty explicit title; fallback evaluated on demand using original raw type and file count
limitations: Label method only. Parent cell appearance, icon, Nib, Entity storage, actor bridges and generated ABI are not promoted.
